newsitem.title: SPAIN: CSFB bought Spain's pastry maker Frida.
newsitem.headline: CSFB bought Spain's pastry maker Frida.

text.p: Credit Suisse First Boston said on Friday it bought a leading Spanish frozen dough manufacturer Frida for undisclosed terms.
CSFB said control of the group switches to it and the company's two main executives Alfonso Duran Pich and Manuel Sellares from previous owners Mercapital and Catalan Bartolome Parera.
Frida had 1996 turnover at 4.5 billion pesetas, with a share of 20 percent of domestic pastry market.
At the close of 1996, Frida had fixed assets of two billion pesetas. And prior to the deal it raised a further two billion pesetas to fund a new factory.
